title: 第十七章 旧案起虚言狡计欲翻空第十八章 旧案终昭雪恶妇罪难逃
lines: 刘管事被杖责驱逐之后，整个丞相府彻底安静下来。
府里上下所有仆婢管事，再无人敢私下议论汀兰院半句，做事恭谨本分，半点不敢懈怠。谁都看得明白，如今的沈清鸢，早已不是从前那个任人拿捏、怯懦天真的嫡小姐，心思缜密、手段利落，待人宽和却绝不容奸，是真正掌得住家、镇得住人的主子。
汀兰院里，连日来都是安稳沉静的模样。
沈清鸢每日晨起对账理家，闲暇之余便陪着张嬷嬷细捋当年旧事，一点点拼凑生母病逝前后的所有细节。阳光透过窗棂落在泛黄的纸页上，母女昔年的旧事、府中旧年的人事变迁，一点点清晰起来。
张嬷嬷坐在一旁，一边回忆一边细细诉说，眼底始终带着愧疚：“老奴当年年纪尚轻，性子愚钝，只敢偷偷藏下药渣物证，不敢明目张胆揭发。柳氏彼时刚入府，温婉恭顺，人人都夸她贤良，谁也想不到她心肠这般歹毒，日日暗下手脚，慢慢拖垮主母身子。”
“我知道。”沈清鸢轻声开口，指尖轻轻摩挲着桌上的药渣残片，“当年府中全是她的人，无人敢仗义执言，不怪嬷嬷。”
她翻看着梳理好的时间线，忽然眉头微蹙：“母亲身边当年除了你，可还有贴身伺候的丫鬟？”
张嬷嬷微微一愣，随即点头：“有的，是个叫春儿的小丫鬟，年纪小，跟着主母三年，手脚伶俐。只是主母病逝那年，她突然被柳氏以‘手脚不净’为由，打发出府，从此再无音讯。”
话音落下，沈清鸢心头瞬间了然。
来了。
柳氏最擅长釜底抽薪。
她如今被禁足，明面无法作乱，便只能在旧案人证上动手脚。张嬷嬷是唯一的人证，若是能找旁人反咬一口、混淆视听，便能彻底推翻所有证词。
果不其然，不过半日，府中便悄然传开了细碎流言。
有人私下低语，说当年被发配农庄的张嬷嬷，是心怀记恨、蓄意报复，故意捏造证据污蔑柳姨娘；说主母当年本就是体弱久病，缠绵病榻多年，与旁人无关。
春桃气得满脸通红，快步走进院内：“小姐！又是凝香院搞的鬼！柳氏让人寻回了当年那个丫鬟春儿，花重金收买了她！那丫鬟如今在外头到处乱说，说柳姨娘素来恭谨善良，从未害过主母，是张嬷嬷记恨旧怨栽赃陷害！”
沈清鸢神色平静，没有半分意外。
困兽之斗，向来如此。
“慌什么。”她抬眼淡淡道，“春儿当年只是外屋伺候的小丫鬟，从未近身端过汤药、守过内室，母亲安胎养病的核心内情，她半点不曾亲历。她的证词，本就作不得数。”
柳氏机关算尽，却偏偏找了个最没用的人证。
当年贴身熬药、近身伺候、日日守在生母身边的，自始至终只有张嬷嬷一人。春儿只是在外打杂，根本接触不到汤药，所言皆是道听途说，全是虚言。
“可府里不知情的下人、甚至几位旁支婶母，都被这些流言误导了！”春桃急道，“再这么传下去，旁人真的会以为是张嬷嬷冤枉好人！”
“越虚的东西，越容易戳破。”沈清鸢缓缓合上卷宗，眸色清冷淡然，“她想靠几句空口白话翻案，太过天真。没有物证支撑，所有谎言都是镜花水月。”
正说着，院外暗卫悄然现身，低声禀报。
“小姐，王爷得知柳氏收买旧仆翻供一事，已命人寻回当年伺候主母抓药的药房老掌柜，此刻已接入京城，安置在外院驿站，随时可传唤入府作证。”
沈清鸢心头微暖。
她从未主动开口求助，可萧聿辞永远事事替她周全。
她查人证，他便替她寻物证；她破流言，他便替她堵死所有后路。前世她孤苦无依、步步血泪，今生却有人默默为她铺好所有路，挡尽所有暗箭。
有药房老掌柜出面作证，当年药方、药量、违禁寒凉药材的记录一一可查，柳氏收买丫鬟的空口谎言，瞬间不攻自破。
而此刻的凝香院内，柳氏还在做着翻盘的美梦。
沈轻柔看着窗外，忐忑不安：“娘亲，那个春儿真的能帮我们翻案吗？万一被查出来是假话怎么办？”
柳氏端着茶杯，眼底藏着阴狠的偏执：“怕什么！空口无凭，沈清鸢只有一个张嬷嬷做人证，我们有春儿辩驳，各执一词，便是疑案！只要案子存疑，没有实锤，老爷和老夫人就不能定我的罪！”
她算计得极好。
只要旧案变成说不清的罗生门，她就能保住性命、摘掉罪名，假以时日风波平息，她依旧能慢慢筹谋反扑。
可她万万想不到，萧聿辞早已为沈清鸢寻来了最硬核的铁证。
柳氏望着窗外湛蓝的天色，咬牙低语：“沈清鸢，你以为赢了一局、掌了家权就稳了？我盘踞相府十几年，你想轻轻松松定我的罪、翻我的案，做梦！”
她蛰伏院内，忍着连日的憋屈，死死等着流言发酵，等着所有人质疑张嬷嬷、质疑沈清鸢，等着给自己翻盘洗白的机会。
却不知，她最后的挣扎，不过是自掘坟墓。
汀兰院内，沈清鸢站起身，眼底彻底没了温度。
人证、物证、时间线、动机，如今样样齐全。
柳氏十几年谋害主母、贪吞嫁妆、构陷嫡女的所有罪孽，终于到了彻底清算的时刻。
“春桃。”她轻声吩咐，“明日晨起，禀明老夫人与父亲，开堂重审生母旧案。”
所有恩怨，所有血海深仇，今日起，尽数了结。
content_en:
After Manager Liu was expelled with the rod, the entire Prime Minister's Mansion became completely quiet.
Of all the servants and maids in charge of the house, no one dared to say a word about Tinglan Yuan in private. They were respectful in their duties and did not dare to slack off at all. Everyone can see clearly that Shen Qingyuan is no longer the cowardly and naive concubine she used to be. She is thoughtful, sharp-minded, gentle with others but never tolerates adultery. She is a master who can truly control the family and control people.
In Tinglan Courtyard, it has been peaceful and quiet for days.
Shen Qingyuan gets up every morning to check the accounts and take care of the family. In his spare time, he accompanies Grandma Zhang to go through the old events in detail, piecing together all the details before and after his biological mother died of illness. The sun shines through the window lattice and falls on the yellowed paper. The past events of the mother and daughter, as well as the changes in personnel in the house, become clearer bit by bit.
Grandma Zhang sat aside and recounted in detail, with guilt in her eyes: "The old slave was still young and dull-tempered. He only dared to secretly hide evidence of the drug residue and did not dare to expose it blatantly. Mrs. Liu had just entered the house at that time. She was gentle and respectful. Everyone praised her for her kindness. No one could have imagined that she had such a vicious heart. She secretly worked every day to slowly bring down the mistress."
"I know." Shen Qingyuan spoke softly, fingertips gently rubbing the remains of the medicine on the table, "Back then, the house was all her people, and no one dared to speak up. I don't blame grandma."
She flipped through the sorted timeline and suddenly frowned: "Aside from you, did my mother have any maids who were waiting for me?"
Grandma Zhang was stunned for a moment, then nodded: "Yes, she is a little maid named Chun'er. She is young and has been with the mistress for three years. Her hands and feet are very smart. But the year the mistress died of illness, she was suddenly sent out of the house by Mrs. Liu on the grounds that her hands and feet were unclean, and she was never heard from again."
After the words fell, Shen Qingyuan's heart suddenly became clear.
Coming.
Mr. Liu is best at removing fuel from the bottom of the cauldron.
Now that she is grounded, she cannot openly cause trouble, so she can only tamper with witnesses in old cases. Nanny Zhang is the only witness. If someone else can come back and confuse the situation, all the testimonies can be completely overturned.
Sure enough, within half a day, small rumors quietly spread in the mansion.
Some people whispered in private that Nanny Zhang, who was sent to the farm back then, was holding a grudge, deliberately retaliating, and deliberately fabricated evidence to slander Aunt Liu; they said that the mistress was already weak and sick for many years, and had nothing to do with others.
Chuntao was so angry that she walked into the courtyard quickly: "Miss! It's Ningxiang Yuan's trouble again! Mrs. Liu asked people to find the maid Chun'er from back then and spent a lot of money to buy her! That maid is now talking nonsense outside, saying that Aunt Liu has always been respectful and kind, and has never harmed the mistress. It was Grandma Zhang who remembered old grudges and framed her!"
Shen Qingyuan looked calm, without any surprise.
The fight between trapped beasts has always been like this.
"Why are you panicking?" She raised her eyes and said calmly, "Chun'er was just a maid serving in the outer room back then. She never served the soup or guarded the inner room. She had no personal experience with the core of the mother's pregnancy and health care. Her testimony was countless."
The Liu family had tried their best to find the most useless witness.
At that time, the only one who cooked the medicine, waited on her, and stayed with her birth mother every day was from the beginning to the end. Chun'er was just doing odd jobs outside and had no access to the decoction and medicine at all. What he said was all hearsay and lies.
"But the uninformed servants in the mansion, and even several aunts from the side, have been misled by these rumors!" Chuntao said anxiously, "If these rumors continue like this, others will really think that Granny Zhang is wronging a good person!"
"The more false something is, the easier it is to expose it." Shen Qingyuan slowly closed the file, her eyes cold and indifferent, "She is too naive to want to overturn the case with a few empty words. There is no physical evidence to support it, and all lies are just a mirror."
Just as he was talking, the secret guard outside the courtyard quietly appeared and reported in a low voice.
"Miss, the prince has learned about Liu's bribery of an old servant to retract his confession, and has ordered people to find the old pharmacy shopkeeper who used to serve his mistress to prepare medicine. He has now been connected to the capital and placed at the outer courtyard post station. He can be summoned to the palace to testify at any time."
Shen Qingyuan's heart felt slightly warm.
She never asked for help, but Xiao Yuci always did everything for her.
When she checks witnesses, he looks for physical evidence for her; when she breaks rumors, he blocks all escape routes for her. In her previous life, she was lonely and helpless, and she shed tears every step of the way. But in this life, there are people who silently pave all the roads for her and block all the hidden arrows.
An old shopkeeper of the pharmacy came forward to testify that the records of prescriptions, dosages, and banned cold and cold medicinal materials could be checked one by one. Liu's empty lie about paying off the maid was instantly revealed.
At this moment, in Ningxiang Courtyard, Mrs. Liu was still dreaming of a comeback.
Shen Qingrou looked out the window, uneasy: "Mom, can that Chun'er really help us reverse the case? What if it's found to be a lie?"
Mrs. Liu was holding the tea cup, with a sinister paranoia hidden in her eyes: "What are you afraid of! Shen Qingyuan has nothing to prove, and Shen Qingyuan only has one witness, Nanny Zhang. We have Chun'er to argue, and each of them insists on his own story, which is a suspicious case! As long as the case is doubtful and there is no solid evidence, the master and the old lady cannot convict me!"
She is very calculating.
As long as the old case turns into an inexplicable Rashomon, she can save her life and get rid of the charges. When the storm subsides, she can still slowly plan a counterattack.
But she never expected that Xiao Yuci had already found the most hard-core ironclad evidence for Shen Qingyuan.
Mrs. Liu looked at the blue sky outside the window, gritted her teeth and whispered: "Shen Qingyuan, do you think that after winning a round and taking control of the family, you will be stable? I have been in the Prime Minister's Mansion for more than ten years, and you want to easily convict me and overturn my case. What a dream!"
She lay dormant in the courtyard, enduring the grievances she felt for days, waiting for the rumors to ferment, waiting for everyone to question Nanny Zhang and Shen Qingyuan, waiting for a chance to clear her name.
Little did he know that her final struggle was just digging her own grave.
In Tinglan Courtyard, Shen Qingyuan stood up, her eyes completely gone.

title_en: Chapter 17: The old case is revealed, and lies and tricks are tried to be undone. Chapter 18: The old case is finally revealed, and the evil woman cannot escape.
